item.title: Service Desk Analyst - IT Support
item.description: Northwind IT builds the systems behind every Northwind Traders warehouse, from receiving docks to the member website. We are a small team that ships often and supports each other.
item.taleo:html-description:
Northwind IT builds the systems behind every Northwind Traders warehouse, from receiving docks to the member website. We are a small team that ships often and supports each other.

In this role you will work with store operations and engineering to keep the product catalog fast and accurate. You will write clear tickets, run sprint reviews and track what shipped.

  • 3+ years in an IT or product role.
  • Comfort with agile tools.
